entities.summary: Zarakh Iliev is a Russian–Azerbaijani billionaire property developer and co-owner of the Kievskaya Ploshchad. As of early March 2024, Forbes estimated his fortune to be $3.3 billion. Iliev is one of the wealthiest people in Russia and ranks 1027th in the ranking of the wealthiest people on the planet.
